content: expo-notifications 57.0.18: plugin options icon/color/defaultChannel/sounds/enableBackgroundRemoteNotifications (iOS, default false - keep false for local-only). scheduleNotificationAsync({content, trigger}) for local; trigger null = immediate. Android 13 POST_NOTIFICATIONS via requestPermissionsAsync; channel must exist first (setNotificationChannelAsync). setNotificationHandler must return behavior within 3s. Remote push needs dev build since SDK 53; not needed for local-only.
